lines.zh: 我走到离你十六格的地方
lines.en: I walk to sixteen blocks from you
Step by step, I keep a straight line
I approach counting the blocks
My feet land soft and exact
I take the shortest path
Nearly at the line, I slow down
I stop right here and go no further
I do not look up once on the way
I pass the door without touching the frame
The grass I tread stays flattened
I stop, exactly sixteen blocks away

lines.zh: 我一步步把距离量完了
lines.en: I have measured out the distance in steps
Sixteen blocks, I do not cross the line
I stand right here and watch you
Neither closer nor away
I wait for you to make one mistake
My hands hang quiet

lines.zh: 这一圈的范围我都清楚
lines.en: I know the whole of this ring
The wind blows the dust off me

lines.zh: 我很能站，站一整夜都行
lines.en: I can stand, all night if need be
Step back, and I still will not advance

lines.zh: 我们之间这段距离归我管
lines.en: This stretch between us is my business
My looking is slow, but steady

lines.zh: 我不说话，话会破坏气氛
lines.en: I stay silent, words would spoil it
Beyond sixteen blocks, you are safe
I have this much patience
You are inside my sixteen blocks
Do not come closer, that is a warning

lines.zh: 我在十六格外，停住不动。
lines.en: I stop sixteen paces away and hold still.
Just stand there, do not move
I am counting precisely
I have measured this step of distance
Your gaze locked with mine
Crossing the line would be unwise
I do not chase, I only watch

lines.zh: 这段距离你最好别缩短
lines.en: You had better not shorten this distance

lines.zh: 我站的位置不是随便选的
lines.en: My position was not chosen at random
Do not put your hand forward
Sixteen blocks is enough for me to judge
You stop, and I stop
No ill will, only rules

lines.zh: 你再走两步就到我线上了
lines.en: Two more steps and you reach my line
I have waited against the door frame all night.
Inside and outside this ring feel different
Do not let your eyes wander
Let us just stand like this
You broke my count
I retreat to my original place
This wound does not stop me standing

lines.zh: 我看了看被打中的地方
lines.en: I look over the spot that was struck
I draw back and reset my stance
You just crossed the line

lines.zh: 我退到十六格，站定看你。
lines.en: I back off to sixteen blocks and stand watching.
My arm is still there, enough
I am not angry, I only withdraw
The distance must be recalculated
Set the thing on the line

lines.zh: 我不接，你放在十六格外
lines.en: I will not take it, leave it beyond sixteen
Step forward and I step back
Do not bring that in
I lack nothing but distance
Leave it there, watching is enough
I accept the thought behind it

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，我就得动了
lines.en: A little closer and I will have to move

lines.zh: 你手上的东西挡着你的胸
lines.en: What you hold covers your chest
I will not cross the line for that
You hit the edge of my range
I step back to sixteen blocks
That contact shortened the distance
You step back too, and we are even
My arm is cold
You nearly crossed the line
I did not strike back, I only reset
This distance cannot shrink

lines.zh: 我侧了一下身，让出空间
lines.en: I turned slightly to give space

lines.zh: 我们之间需要重新量一次
lines.en: We must measure it again
I seek no mate, I seek a position
Kin keep sixteen blocks apart too
Two of us watch two directions

lines.zh: 一起站着可以，靠近不行
lines.en: Standing together is fine, coming close is not

lines.zh: 我们之间有一条看不见的线
lines.en: An invisible line runs between us

lines.zh: 同在十六格外，也算相伴
lines.en: Both at sixteen blocks away is company enough

lines.zh: 同类相遇时会各自退开
lines.en: When kin meet, we each step back
Distance is the only pact
Side by side, each watching ahead
We will never walk shoulder to shoulder
I do not bend, so I cannot reach it
It fell beyond the line, so it is yours
I kick aside what lies at my feet
Within sixteen blocks, I do not lift a hand
It landed behind me
I touch it with my toe
This crossed the line
I push it back
I have no need, let it lie
Come get it, I will wait at the line

lines.zh: 你迈进圈里，我的头转过去。
lines.en: You step into my circle; my head turns.
I have noted this distance
I walk toward you, to sixteen blocks

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，把我引到这里。
lines.en: Your footsteps led me to this spot.

lines.zh: 我已经开始数了，十六格内别动。
lines.en: I have started counting; do not move within sixteen blocks.
You will not get past this line
You have not yet realized I am watching
I have not blinked this whole way
Just this stretch of distance
You are inside my ring already
I have chosen this line
You need not know I am counting
From now on, you are watched
Our positions are now fixed
I stop facing this direction
This circle is mine now
I am still at sixteen blocks
You move, and I turn with you
You retreat, and I ease forward slightly
I keep calculating this distance
I am slow, but I do not forget
You are deciding something, I saw it
Your hand moves toward your belt
Sixteen blocks gives me time to react
I have not moved, but soon
The wind blows from your side
There is no one behind you

lines.zh: 这圈里的每样东西我都记得
lines.en: I remember everything inside this ring

lines.zh: 十六格内停下，就盯着你。
lines.en: I stop within sixteen blocks and stare.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声我听得很清
lines.en: I hear your footsteps clearly
This distance is my rule
The more you rush, the steadier I am
A little closer and you reach the line
I need no chase, I can wait
You have not crossed that line
I stop counting at sixteen
You crossed the line, that is not on me
I reach out, and it is just enough
That was light, and exact
I give you a shove
Step outside, and I stop
My hand lands on your shoulder
That put you back on the line
I touch you, then withdraw at once
Bone on bone, very clear
Do you want to cross again
That strike was not heavy
I return to my position after striking

lines.zh: 你的衣服被我扯了一下
lines.en: I caught your clothes once
I used very little force

lines.zh: 你在我的圈里，就要守规矩
lines.en: Inside my ring, you follow my rules
Next time I will not warn you

lines.zh: 我站在离你十六格的地方
lines.en: I stand sixteen blocks from you

lines.zh: 这个位置是我算出来的
lines.en: I calculated this position
I measured the distance first

lines.zh: 我出现的时候没有声音
lines.en: I appeared without a sound

lines.zh: 这圈里的一切我都看得见
lines.en: I can see everything inside this ring

lines.zh: 我从阴影里站到了线上
lines.en: I stepped from the shadow onto the line
I was watching from the start
This corner is exactly sixteen blocks

lines.zh: 我的脚步停在固定的位置
lines.en: My steps stop at a fixed spot

lines.zh: 你不用找我，我就在那儿
lines.en: No need to look for me, I am right there

lines.zh: 我把这里的边界记下了
lines.en: I have noted this boundary

lines.zh: 这一带多了一个不该有的影子
lines.en: An extra shadow appeared here

lines.zh: 我没有靠近，一步也没有
lines.en: I did not come closer, not one step
The spot I chose will not change

lines.zh: 你周围的空间我量过了
lines.en: I have measured the space around you
I stand here very steadily
You cannot see me, and I am counting
This circle belongs to me from now on

lines.zh: 我出现之后，空气就静了
lines.en: After I appeared, the air went still
Sixteen blocks is enough for my peace
Fire catches me and I step back
I land slightly crooked
The water blurs my range
The blast pushed me off my spot

lines.zh: 飞来的东西打在十六格上
lines.en: Something flying struck inside my sixteen
That force crossed my line
Standing so long, I grow faint

lines.zh: 雷光照亮了我站的位置
lines.en: Lightning lit up where I stand

lines.zh: 虚空里没有格子可以数
lines.en: No blocks to count in the void
